cost: List O(B); hashing O(file bytes) with 1 MiB buffer. Archive filtering O(uncompressed bytes) plus gzip cost; max kept entry 5 MiB but total input has no cap. Manifest O(D log S) plus serialized bytes; effects and delays are external costs.
description: read_list validates columns and rows; run checks free space, then for each row creates slug directory and hashes existing file before STOP/cap. Fresh path checks blocked host, space, robots, bounded download, extension/signature, optional text compaction, then records Done. write_manifest groups Done by sorted slug and writes JSONL then TSV.
forward: read_list validates columns and rows; run checks free space, then for each row creates slug directory and hashes existing file before STOP/cap. Fresh path checks blocked host, space, robots, bounded download, extension/signature, optional text compaction, then records Done. write_manifest groups Done by sorted slug and writes JSONL then TSV.
inverse: Invalid required columns or disallowed license prevent run from reaching free-space or network setup. Unknown response extension and bad signature delete the candidate and do not append Done. These exclusions do not apply to already existing files.

Manifest file record admits any Item/Done pair matching retained fields and valid item_idx; original tar contents dropped by compaction are unrecoverable. Hash equality is an observation, not a unique byte inverse. JSON groups preserve per-group order but not original cross-group interleaving.
limitations: No network/DNS/download, real catalog/corpus/model/teacher or database execution. Effect paths are source-derived; finite helper tests are not universal verification. No executable percentage surrogate or speed claim; future caps require metric/domain/reference and remain 1/2/5/10%.
state: All rows are license-validated before download setup. Existing wildcard choice is filesystem-order dependent and bypasses signature/STOP/cap checks. Done item_idx must be in range. Aggregate format uses HashSet iteration; do not claim byte-deterministic mixed-format JSON.
